def: A timed exercise done on your own, usually two to six hours, with an incomplete brief, which a reviewer then discusses with you.
An engineer embedded with a customer to make a system work in their environment, working across many capabilities for one customer.
The simplest approach that could work, built and measured first, so that any later system has something honest to beat.
A small labelled set drawn deliberately from each kind of case, including awkward ones, rather than sampled at random.
A short conversation after a take-home in which you explain your choices, your results and their limits.
The projects and writing a reviewer can inspect without you present, whose job is to make the claims on your CV checkable.
A short write-up that reads a sample of failures, names the first thing that went wrong in each, counts the categories and says what to fix first.
A subset of cases sharing a property, such as a document type, reported separately because an overall score can hide a weak slice.
